subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should sidebar group management proceed through the linked Control UI-only PR, or should maintainers choose a different UX/API direction before implementation?
rationale: The issue requests new visible sidebar controls and a persisted browser-local preference, carries a protected maintainer label, and already has an open linked implementation candidate.

options.title: Review linked PR
options.body: Rebase/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the implementation path and close this issue only after it lands or is replaced.

options.title: Redesign first
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a different sidebar group-management UX or API boundary before accepting the current PR shape.

options.title: Decline sidebar group management
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR only if maintainers decide sidebar groups should remain lightweight and write-once.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR
